args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity):
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The fix is
in 2.9.4 (2.x line), so we stay on the 2.x major to avoid the
breaking changes in 3.x.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

## Details
- The advisory marks affected ranges `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; the fix is available in 2.9.4 (2.x line) and 3.1.0.
- We upgrade within the 2.x major to 2.9.4, the minimal version fixing the CVE, avoiding the breaking changes of the 3.x major.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.
